full_text:
== Playing Strategies ==
Because of his high ATK and DEF Dante can defeat most hero without defeat himself. Using him in combination with Hyperstride allows Dante to cover a lot of ground in a short amount of time. For the Heroes too strong for him to defeat his Megapunch ability can KO any hero.

== Trivia ==
* This Card is almost the same as PRO-004 - Dante Vale: Private Investigator.
